description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Draws a frame over an image and returns a new image URL (the original is untouched). Use the URL in create_content, or pass contentId + platform so that post publishes the framed image on that platform. Free by default; the same inputs again are free.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/frames/apply.)

aspect.description: Default: nearest to the source image.

contentId.description: A content id: its publish swaps this framed image in for `platform`.

paletteOverride.description: Colors that win over the brand kit. Every key is optional; omitted keys fall back to the brand kit palette. Each present key must be a #rrggbb hex.

platform.description: Platform this framed image is for ("all" by default).

sourceUrl.description: https image URL (flayr/Convex storage or a stock host).

texts.description: Texts some frames print (ribbon/tag label, lower-third title/subtitle).

name: apply_frame
title: Frame an image
